_about: The cut. Scenes q1–q4 and the score are written on the source timeline (0–238 s); the finished film is assembled from these pieces in order. `src` plays a stretch of the source; `scene` is new material drawn on the film's own clock (render/scenes/intro.js). `join` is how a stretch meets the one before it: `hold` across a still moment, `cut` at a cut in the picture, `step` on a beat of the Iris blink. Nothing visibly jumps. render/film.js, audio/score.py and deliver.py all read this file; script.json's times are on the finished film's clock.
